title: G05: security/privacy/AI-safety gate contract (threat-model / privacy-assessment / supply-chain-plan / security-approval)
objective: Enforce Gate 05, declared in lifecycle.json but unbacked: give its four required_evidence types per-type rules in validate_evidence, exactly as G01-G04, so the gate OPENS each artifact. Ship examples/gate-dossier.G05.json (C2, validated in CI) and prove an instance advances G04->G05 on a valid G05 dossier.
business_value: Without per-type rules a G05 dossier passes on names alone. This makes the four security exit criteria -- threats controlled, privacy obligations addressed, dependency+secret controls planned, residual risk owned -- deterministic gate refusals, with the security approval bound by digest to the threat model and owned by a human security_authority.
in_scope: check_threat_model / check_privacy_assessment / check_supply_chain_plan / check_security_approval in badf_gate.py + registration in EVIDENCE_RULES
examples/gate-dossier.G05.json (C2, four authority roles) + its four evidence/artifact pairs; CI validates it
tests/test_badf_g05.py (failing-first) + a G04->G05 pair-acceptance in tests/test_badf_advance.py
mutation; own G07 self-dossier; doctrine section in GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md
out_of_scope: a badf-security authoring skill (a later WP if a real task needs it)
later gates G06+ -- one WP each; any change to G05 authority
acceptance_criteria: a threat with no mitigation, a data category with no lawful basis/handling, missing secret controls, an uncontrolled dependency are each refused
a non-human security-approval, a missing residual_risk_owner, and a threat_model_digest mismatch are each refused
an instance at G04/APPROVED advances to G05/APPROVED on a valid G05 dossier
mutation kills; compose green both shapes; PyYAML-absent suite green

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; the next WP reconciles it. Reuses the G01-G04 substrate -- no new validator module. G05 min change class is C2, so the example dossier carries the four C2 authority roles (product_owner/engineering_owner/quality_authority/service_owner); security-approval mirrors product-approval (human, digest-bound). Reconciles WP-2026-0059.
